title: Narcos: Mexico
overview: اِشهد ميلاد حرب المخدرات في المكسيك في الثمانينيّات، إذ تؤرخ ملحمة واقعية جديدة من مسلسل Narcos قصة صعود عصابة "كارتل غوادالاخارا" الحقيقية.

ai_content.desc_en: See the rise of the Guadalajara Cartel as an American DEA agent learns the danger of targeting narcos in 1980s Mexico. This gripping drama series explores the harsh realities of the war on drugs in Mexico and the cat-and-mouse game between law enforcement and the cartels. The series delves into the complexities of the US-Mexico relationship and the impact of the Guadalajara Cartel's rise on the region.
